1	# Education Investment vs. Outcomes: 30-Country Comparison
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	This dataset compiles education-related metrics for 30 countries spanning Europe, Asia, the Americas, and Oceania. It pairs public education spending with three outcome dimensions — academic performance, tertiary access, and youth labor market integration — to enable cross-country comparison.
     5	
     6	## Data Source
     7	
     8	### education_spending
     9	One row per country. Fields: `country` (string, country name), `region` (string, broad geographic grouping), `edu_spending_pct_gdp` (float, public education expenditure as % of GDP, range ~2.9–7.2%). Based on OECD/World Bank estimates circa 2022.
    10	
    11	### pisa_scores
    12	One row per country. Fields: `country` (string), `pisa_avg` (integer, average of reading, math, and science scores from PISA 2022, range 379–561).
    13	
    14	### tertiary_enrollment
    15	One row per country. Fields: `country` (string), `enrollment_rate` (integer, gross tertiary enrollment as % of the relevant age cohort, range 43–110%). Values above 100% are possible due to mature-age and international students.
    16	
    17	### youth_unemployment
    18	One row per country. Fields: `country` (string), `youth_unemp_rate` (float, unemployment rate for ages 15–24 as % of youth labor force, range ~4.1–30.2%). Data circa 2022–2023.
    19	
    20	## Data Notes
    21	- All four datasets share the same 30 countries and are joinable on the `country` field.
    22	- Gross enrollment rates can exceed 100% due to inclusion of students outside the typical age cohort.
    23	- PISA scores represent a combined average; individual subject scores may differ.
    24	- Youth unemployment definitions follow ILO standards but national measurement practices may vary slightly.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publication-ready bubble chart: Education Spending vs Outcomes (30 countries)."""

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

spending = {d['country']: d for d in data['education_spending']['data']}
pisa = {d['country']: d for d in data['pisa_scores']['data']}
enroll = {d['country']: d for d in data['tertiary_enrollment']['data']}
unemp = {d['country']: d for d in data['youth_unemployment']['data']}

countries = sorted(spending.keys())

x = np.array([spending[c]['edu_spending_pct_gdp'] for c in countries])
y = np.array([pisa[c]['pisa_avg'] for c in countries])
sizes = np.array([enroll[c]['enrollment_rate'] for c in countries])
colors = np.array([unemp[c]['youth_unemp_rate'] for c in countries])
regions = [spending[c]['region'] for c in countries]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Style configuration (editorial / analytical)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans'],
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'axes.titlesize': 14,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'figure.dpi': 150,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#333333',
    'axes.labelcolor': '#333333',
    'xtick.color': '#333333',
    'ytick.color': '#333333',
    'text.color': '#333333',
    'figure.facecolor': '#fafafa',
    'axes.facecolor': '#ffffff',
    'axes.grid.which': 'major',
    'axes.grid.axis': 'both',
    'grid.color': '#e0e0e0',
    'grid.linewidth': 0.8,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#fafafa')
ax.set_facecolor('#ffffff')

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bubble scatter
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize sizes for plotting (enrollment 43-110 -> area roughly 80-1100)
size_scale = lambda val: ((val - 40) / (115 - 40)) * 1000 + 80
scatter_sizes = np.array([size_scale(v) for v in sizes])

# Diverging colormap for unemployment: low (good) = blue, high (bad) = red
norm = plt.Normalize(vmin=colors.min(), vmax=colors.max())
cmap = plt.cm.RdYlBu_r

sc = ax.scatter(
    x, y,
    s=scatter_sizes,
    c=colors,
    cmap=cmap,
    norm=norm,
    alpha=0.85,
    edgecolors='#333333',
    linewidths=0.6,
    zorder=3,
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Notable country labels (efficiency outliers, high spenders mixed, disconnect)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
notable = {
    'Singapore': (8, 4),
    'Japan': (8, 4),
    'Estonia': (8, 4),
    'Sweden': (-10, -12),
    'Costa Rica': (8, -12),
    'Brazil': (8, -12),
    'Spain': (8, -10),
    'Italy': (8, -10),
    'Greece': (8, -10),
    'South Korea': (8, 4),
    'United States': (8, -10),
    'France': (8, -10),
    'Turkey': (-10, 4),
    'Australia': (8, -10),
    'Ireland': (8, 4),
    'Chile': (8, -10),
    'Mexico': (8, 4),
}

for c in countries:
    if c in notable:
        dx, dy = notable[c]
        ax.annotate(
            c,
            (spending[c]['edu_spending_pct_gdp'], pisa[c]['pisa_avg']),
            xytext=(dx, dy),
            textcoords='offset points',
            fontsize=9,
            fontweight='bold',
            color='#222222',
            ha='center' if abs(dx) < 15 else ('left' if dx > 0 else 'right'),
            va='center' if abs(dy) < 15 else ('bottom' if dy > 0 else 'top'),
            arrowprops=dict(
                arrowstyle='-', color='#555555', lw=0.7,
                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1'
            ) if abs(dx) > 15 or abs(dy) > 10 else None,
            zorder=4,
        )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Axis, title, labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
ax.set_xlabel('Education Spending (% of GDP)', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Average PISA Score (Reading, Math, Science)', labelpad=10)
ax.set_title(
    'Education Spending vs. Student Performance Across 30 Countries\n'
    'Bubble size = tertiary enrollment rate; colour = youth unemployment rate',
    fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=18
)

ax.set_xlim(2.3, 7.6)
ax.set_ylim(360, 580)
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(20))
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(0.5))
ax.grid(True, linestyle='-', alpha=0.4)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Colorbar (youth unemployment)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cbar = fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, pad=0.02, shrink=0.7, aspect=25)
cbar.set_label('Youth Unemployment Rate (% of youth labor force, ages 15–24)', labelpad=12)
cbar.outline.set_edgecolor('#cccccc')
cbar.outline.set_linewidth(0.5)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Size legend (tertiary enrollment)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create representative sizes
size_vals = [50, 70, 90, 110]
legend_sizes = [size_scale(v) for v in size_vals]
legend_bubbles = []
for s, v in zip(legend_sizes, size_vals):
    legend_bubbles.append(
        ax.scatter([], [], s=s, c='#999999', alpha=0.6, edgecolors='#333333', linewidths=0.6, label=f'{v}%')
    )

size_legend = ax.legend(
    legend_bubbles,
    [f'{v}%' for v in size_vals],
    title='Tertiary Enrollment\n(% of age cohort)',
    loc='lower right',
    frameon=True,
    edgecolor='#cccccc',
    fontsize=9,
    title_fontsize=10,
    labelspacing=1.2,
    handletextpad=1.5,
    borderpad=0.8,
)
size_legend.get_frame().set_facecolor('#ffffff')
size_legend.get_frame().set_alpha(0.95)
ax.add_artist(size_legend)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final polish
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
print('Saved /app/output/result.png')
